config.aggregate: sum of the 19 tradeable symbols' staged OI levels (denominator only)
config.benchmark: BTCUSDT context-only (never ranked, never held, never inside the aggregate)
config.cross_section: complete declared-universe cross-section required per window (fail-closed, no partial aggregate)
config.data: staged OI v11_oi_staging_v1 (oi_data/consolidated, per-file SHA-256 pinned in research/control/v11_run/oi_staging_manifest.json; availability = the row's own create_time, read per row); bars for execution/pricing only; funding COST ONLY, never in any signal
config.decision_clock: discretionary decisions weekly Monday 00:00:00Z (52 scheduled, 51 effective after the 1-day calendar-zone purge); DAILY conditioning refreshed from the daily staged-OI path with availability = the row's own create_time (read per row, never assumed); ONE declared execution lag (slot-open fill at T+15m)
config.deleted_by_construction: no differencing, no regression, no OI-flow direction anywhere in the control quantity
config.drop_one_pin: held max-|weight| symbol, remaining weights unchanged, no renormalisation
config.exit_rule: held side exits only when the rank crosses beyond the median (exit = flip); buffer never forces an exit
config.falsification: if CTL-OISHARE passes {expectancy>0, PF>=1.10, >=2/3 folds positive} while the anchor passes, the edge is an OI-dominance/size artifact and A14-V14-A8-OICYC is FALSIFIED as a cycle-participation mechanism; the control is never promotable
config.folds_contract: chronological 3-fold force-flat per the pinned V12 fold calendar (F0 2025-08-22..2025-12-21, F1 2025-12-22..2026-04-21, F2 2026-04-22..2026-08-21) with the frozen 1-day purge as a CALENDAR ZONE [end - 1d, end) -- the measured V13 convention, exactly one stamp (2026-04-20) purged, 51 effective Mondays at 17/17/17; per-family cell matrices derived from the family's own folds contract (L-V11-1)
config.quantity: SH_s = mean own share of the aggregate OI over the 28 most recent daily rows <= T
config.section_1_1_disclosure: shadow-region entry per PLAN_crypto_v14.md Section 1.1: the sign region was observed in the V12 OILEV-V2-28D-FLOW-W-INV causal control arm (+0.758 raw vs anchor -0.821); preregistered CONFIRMATORY status is recorded in the verdict record and in the observed/published denominator accounting; own falsification control CTL-OISHARE; |rho| <= 0.20 vs the OILEV-V2 anchor AND its inverted control (A7-N measured 0.0112, PASS); no gate relaxation
config.sort: ascending on SH value (long lowest-share tercile, short highest-share tercile); frozen 'rank DESCENDING on SH_s' carried as the descending rank presentation in payload diagnostics
